verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents deploying straight from a local project directory with the CLI (`fly launch` run inside the source directory, 'Ship from GitHub or our CLI'), so no Git repo is required. Nothing in the evidence shows a new deployment staying private or unpublished until the developer chooses to release it. missing for 10: a private/unpublished deployment state with an explicit publish step, independent hands-on confirmation of folder-upload deploys.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy a project by uploading a folder of files directly, with no Git repo required and the new deployment kept private until I choose to publish it

citations.quote: Run `fly launch` from inside your project source directory to create, configure, and (for most apps) deploy a new application.
Ship from GitHub or our CLI with `fly launch`.
You’ll use the `fly` command to create and deploy apps
